display_name: 独立频域时域直接恢复网络源域原型
description: 输入自适应全频复滤波与多尺度时域修正，直接输出恢复 IQ，冻结地面基座；不依赖 DURA 和盲后验。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU2 source-only direct spectral temporal pilot; CPU 2 threads TF32 disabled; source L_s and U_s gradient preflight

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256]; direct input-conditioned complex spectrum plus multiscale time correction; paired source IQ and frozen F guide training
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: L_s metadata contains 6300 truth labels; only fit-ID L_s truth enters loss; no U_s truth, V or test read
data.validation_ref: 384 fixed source RX8 records, 64 per impaired scene; no true labels used in evaluation
data.leo_config_ref: Fresh source cache epoch21/22/23 training, original source cache epoch19 evaluation

permissions.query_use: L_s source train labels only in optimizer; U_s truth, V and test remain inaccessible
permissions.claim_scope: Source physical IDs observed in previous channel views, RX8 same prior pilot; no independent blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Random direct network with identity output; F frozen; DURA loaded only after optimization for comparison. No Bayesian parent loaded.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact Phase1 source interface release 848c4b4c47b054f43c8303638e5aa549154ebfd4; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL contract; source-only metadata and role verification.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Three fixed epochs over 4096 source fit IDs, final epoch checkpoint; fixed 384 source RX8 records; no automatic Phase1 test.

execution.launch_owner: Codex direct spectral source pilot GPU2 owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 single owner, TF32 disabled, source-only training; real L_s/U_s gradient preflight
execution.launch_command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONPATH=/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261101-phase1-physical-rich-router-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261027-phase1-pamf-repl-shuffled-views-m16-r02-release /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261102-phase1-direct-spectral-pilot-s2026092701-r02-release/experiments/phase1_direct_spectral/train_source.py --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --out /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261102-phase1-direct-spectral-pilot-s2026092701-r02 --commit 098b93c6b6e8f6365cf42a3339f478e376fcf145 --device cuda:0
execution.stop_rule: Stop only for provenance or role violation, output collision, nonfinite values or technical failure; preserve partial output; never stop for low performance

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Source RX8 clean-F pseudo targets not true labels; L_s train truth used only on fit IDs. No target predictions.

rows.method: input conditioned complex spectral filter plus multiscale dilated IQ refinement
rows.purpose: test independent direct restoration without DURA or Bayesian parent
rows.seed_notes: 4096 source training subset and order seed 2026120955; fixed source RX8 draws 2026120355
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 4096 source IDs, batch16, three source views and 384 source RX8 holdout

notes: L_s metadata loads 6300 labels for physical ID verification; only fit L_s labels enter loss; U_s truth not loaded.
DURA loaded only after training for comparison; no Bayesian parent loaded.
Source physical IDs observed previously in other channel views; not independent blind or real satellite.
No V or Phase1 test IQ; no automatic target testing.
r01 preflight failed before training because of model import name collision; r02 renames the module and repeats full source preflight.
